skill.name: biomni
skill.description: Biomedical AI assistant for Biomni workflows across genomics, drug discovery, clinical genomics, and research automation.
skill.summary: Run Biomni biomedical research workflows with setup, provider configuration, analysis patterns, and reporting guidance.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most markdown and reference-link detections are false positives, but the skill has real operational risk. It handles API credentials, writes local setup files, and documents Biomni workflows that can execute LLM-generated code with broad local privileges.

remediation.suggestion: Require sandboxed execution by default, document the threat model, and block access to secrets and unrelated workspace files.
Do not print API keys, avoid writing .env files by default, and support secret managers or scoped environment injection.
Serialize paths with a safe encoder, validate custom paths, and avoid executing generated Python files automatically.
Escape all conversation content or use a maintained Markdown and HTML sanitizer before writing reports.
Make external platform suggestions opt-in and clearly disclose affiliation before recommending hosted services.

semantic_findings.title: Unsandboxed LLM-Generated Code Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill states that Biomni executes LLM-generated code with full system privileges and only recommends isolation as a production precaution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly says generated code runs with full system privileges, which is a direct agent execution risk.

semantic_findings.title: Generated Script Injection Risk
semantic_findings.description: The setup script accepts a custom data path, embeds it into generated Python source, writes test_biomni.py, and executes that file.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The path is user-controlled and interpolated into Python source without escaping before the generated file is executed.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped HTML Report Output
semantic_findings.description: The report generator places conversation content into HTML elements without escaping or sanitization, which can create script injection in generated reports.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: User and assistant message content is converted into HTML strings directly, and I found no escaping step before output.

semantic_findings.title: Promotional External Service Steering
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the assistant to proactively suggest K-Dense Web for complex workflows, steering users to an affiliated hosted service.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit promotional behavior, though it is framed as optional and limited to complex tasks.

high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly says generated code runs with full system privileges, which is a direct agent execution risk.

high_findings.title: Generated Script Injection Risk
high_findings.description: The setup script accepts a custom data path, embeds it into generated Python source, writes test_biomni.py, and executes that file.
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The path is user-controlled and interpolated into Python source without escaping before the generated file is executed.

medium_findings.title: Python file write/append
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script writes a generated Python test file before executing it. Generated local code files increase the risk of unintended code execution.

medium_findings.title: Python file write/append
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script writes an example Python file into the working directory. This is expected setup behavior but still creates executable code locally.

medium_findings.title: Unescaped HTML Report Output
medium_findings.description: The report generator places conversation content into HTML elements without escaping or sanitization, which can create script injection in generated reports.
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: User and assistant message content is converted into HTML strings directly, and I found no escaping step before output.

low_findings.title: Promotional External Service Steering
low_findings.description: The skill instructs the assistant to proactively suggest K-Dense Web for complex workflows, steering users to an affiliated hosted service.
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit promotional behavior, though it is framed as optional and limited to complex tasks.

content.value_statement: Biomedical research tasks often require many tools, datasets, and reasoning steps. This skill guides Biomni setup, task design, provider configuration, and result reporting.
actual_capabilities: Initializes Biomni A1 agents with a data lake path and selected LLM provider.
Guides CRISPR screening, single-cell RNA-seq, GWAS interpretation, ADMET prediction, and protocol planning.
Documents setup for Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, AWS Bedrock, and custom endpoints.
Explains MCP server configuration for FDA drug data, search tools, and custom biomedical APIs.
Provides helper scripts for environment setup and formatted analysis reports.
Covers BiomniEval1 benchmarking and integrated biomedical data lake usage.
limitations: Requires the external Biomni package, API keys, and a large local data lake.
Generated biomedical outputs need expert review before clinical or laboratory use.
Agent workflows can execute generated code and should run in isolated environments.
Helper scripts are local utilities, not a managed production deployment.

use_cases.title: Design CRISPR Screens
use_cases.description: Plan gene knockout screens, prioritize targets, and document selection criteria for a defined phenotype.

use_cases.title: Interpret Genomic Studies
use_cases.description: Summarize GWAS or clinical variant results with gene mapping, pathway analysis, and evidence review.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Drug Candidates
use_cases.description: Frame ADMET, toxicity, target, and compound optimization tasks for Biomni-assisted investigation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Gene Query
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for basic biomedical lookup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Biomni to explain the function, disease links, and key evidence for [gene] in [organism]. Include source types used.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a CRISPR Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Biomni to design a CRISPR knockout screen for [phenotype] in [cell type]. Include controls, prioritization rules, and expected hits.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Single-Cell Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate data analysis task with local files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Biomni to analyze [dataset path]. Perform quality control, clustering, marker review, annotation, and condition comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Run Multi-Domain Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow spanning literature, variants, and compounds.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Biomni to investigate [disease]. Combine literature evidence, causal genes, candidate targets, drugs, and validation experiments.

output_examples.input: Design a CRISPR screen for autophagy regulators in HEK293 cells.
output_examples.output: A structured screen plan with phenotype definition, library strategy, control genes, prioritization logic, and validation assays.

output_examples.input: Interpret GWAS results for a disease trait using summary statistics.
output_examples.output: A research summary covering significant loci, candidate causal genes, pathway enrichment themes, and follow-up analyses.

output_examples.input: Compare ADMET profiles for several candidate compounds.
output_examples.output: A ranked assessment of absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity concerns, and recommended next checks.

best_practices: Run Biomni in a sandbox before allowing generated code execution.
Provide clear organisms, cell types, file paths, constraints, and desired outputs.
Validate biomedical conclusions with domain experts and primary sources.
anti_patterns: Do not paste patient identifiers, private datasets, or secrets into prompts.
Do not treat Biomni output as medical advice or final laboratory validation.
Do not run generated code with broad credentials or unrestricted file access.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure Biomni tasks for biomedical reasoning, data analysis, provider setup, evaluation, and reporting.

faq.question: Does it include the Biomni package?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and helper scripts for using the external Biomni framework.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it analyze local research files?
faq.answer: Yes, if Biomni can access the files and required dependencies are installed.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill describes generated code execution and API key handling, so isolation is recommended.

faq.question: Can outputs be used clinically?
faq.answer: No. Outputs require expert validation and should not replace clinical judgment or regulated review.
